scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

apps.access_detail: Personal tokens or registered apps; organization approval/SSO may restrict customer resources.
apps.surface: REST + GraphQL; repos, issues, PRs, actions and administration
apps.note: Prefer a least-privilege GitHub App for multi-tenant automation; personal tokens suit prototypes.
apps.workflow: Read a public repository, then scoped issues
apps.next_action: Use the existing public-repository demo as a smoke test, then authorize a least-privilege GitHub App to read issues in one test repository.
apps.success_criterion: Keep the public HTTP-200 result separate from a new authenticated issue-read test and record granted repository permissions.
apps.alternative_action: Compare official MCP issue tools with required fields and installation boundaries before adding custom REST tools.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Account access tokens; plan-specific deployment/resource limits need verification.
apps.surface: REST; projects, deployments, domains and teams
apps.note: A platform that hosts MCP servers does not by itself prove a native account-management MCP exists.
apps.next_action: Confirm Vercel API access on the selected plan and use a team-scoped token to inspect a test deployment.
apps.success_criterion: Return deployment and project identifiers within the selected team; record account limits.
apps.alternative_action: Inspect an authorized deployment UI request only for a required field absent from the public API; hosting MCP servers is not native MCP coverage.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Generate a personal access token or register OAuth application; team access is explicit.
apps.surface: REST; sites, builds, deployments and team resources
apps.note: Separate API availability from build/runtime usage credits.

mcp.scope: Build, deploy and manage Netlify resources

apps.workflow: Read a test site's deployment status
apps.next_action: Confirm Netlify API eligibility and use a scoped account token to read one test site's deployment metadata.
apps.success_criterion: Return the site/deploy identifiers and distinguish API access from build/runtime credit usage.
apps.alternative_action: Use deployment webhooks for status updates if polling is unnecessary; verify the webhook contract and plan allowance.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Create a scoped token in dashboard; product entitlement and account role govern each service.
apps.surface: REST + GraphQL analytics; broad infrastructure resources
apps.note: A single broad global key is not required; scope the token to target resources.
apps.next_action: Confirm Cloudflare API eligibility for the chosen product and create a read-only token limited to one test zone.
apps.success_criterion: List the approved zone's records and verify access is denied outside its scope.
apps.alternative_action: Compare the relevant official MCP server with this zone-scoped workflow instead of using a broad global key.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.access_detail: Two free projects plus project API credentials support a scoped database prototype; management roles and quotas still apply.
apps.surface: Management REST; project REST/GraphQL, storage and auth
apps.note: Free project route is inferred from billing and project API docs; keep project keys separate from management tokens and enforce row-level security.
apps.workflow: Read rows protected by row-level security
apps.next_action: Create a free Supabase test project, seed two differently owned rows, and query through the project API with the intended user context.
apps.success_criterion: Return only permitted rows; record RLS behavior and keep management tokens out of the data-plane test.
apps.alternative_action: Use the project REST or GraphQL surface for records; reserve management MCP for project administration.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Graph database and managed graph hosting
apps.access_detail: Self-hosted database credentials; Aura management has separate client credentials and entitlements.
apps.surface: HTTP Query API + Aura management; Cypher queries and infrastructure
apps.note: Basic/Bearer database query auth and Aura OAuth are distinct; a graph database is not a GraphQL API.

mcp.scope: Schema introspection and Cypher read/write; database credentials and optional read-only mode

apps.workflow: Run a read-only local Cypher query
apps.next_action: Use a local Neo4j database and a read-only query identity to retrieve a small seeded graph through the Query API or MCP.
apps.success_criterion: Return the expected nodes and relationships; document database auth separately from Aura management OAuth.
apps.alternative_action: Keep graph query execution separate from infrastructure provisioning and constrain query/time limits.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result

apps.description: Cloud data warehouse and data platform
apps.access_detail: Account role and authentication policy required; trial eligibility not verified in this pass.
apps.surface: REST + SQL API; query execution and platform resources
apps.note: Key-pair JWT, OAuth and programmatic access tokens are supported; role and network policy still constrain use.

mcp.scope: Managed Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents and configured SQL/custom tools; OAuth and RBAC

apps.workflow: Execute a bounded Snowflake read query
apps.next_action: Confirm trial/API eligibility and role/network policies, then run a small read-only SQL API query with one supported credential type.
apps.success_criterion: Record the role, warehouse/cost limit, query ID and result; verify the chosen auth scheme.
apps.alternative_action: Use official MCP only after checking role and query-execution boundaries; do not imply an API token bypasses network policy.
apps.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
